need: Probability classifier for small-sample binary price-path targets (T1, T1b, T2): train-only fit, predict_proba, deterministic seed, serializable artifact
binding_constraints: 100 to 300 eligible events per target (ACCEPTANCE_METRICS); B2 is logistic regression on a few as-of features; Python 3.13, CPU only, offline

need: Calibration and proper scoring: Brier, log loss, Brier skill versus prevalence, reliability bins with counts, Platt, isotonic or Venn-Abers on training data only
binding_constraints: Wilson 95% tolerance, quantile bins of at least 20, at most 5 bins (contract.ACCEPTANCE)

need: Uncertainty and abstention: intervals on skill (day-block and mint-block bootstrap), multiple-testing adjustment (Holm), conformal or selective prediction that can refuse
binding_constraints: wider of the two bootstrap intervals governs; abstention reasons are visible, never a score

need: Walk-forward evaluation: expanding window by UTC day, purge and embargo for overlapping horizons, group (mint) splits and sensitivity
binding_constraints: existing LabelGate and split_bounds are one fractional split (GAP_MATRIX note); every fit sees only labels matured by its cutoff

need: Event labels: first-touch barrier labels on a price path and time-to-event with censoring (competing risks: target first versus invalidation first)
binding_constraints: labels PENDING until matured; censored classes counted, never dropped (PI-D-021)

need: Point-in-time features from 5-minute candles and snapshots: technical and statistical features, change points and regime state, with no look-ahead
binding_constraints: provider lag 300 s HEURISTIC; empty intervals omitted by the vendor; features must pass the truncation-invariance check

need: Analog cohorts and regime-aware estimates for low-history tokens: nearest neighbours, pattern matching, regime models
binding_constraints: no regime claim from 17 days of one regime (ACCEPTANCE_METRICS); out-of-distribution means abstain

need: Drift and degradation monitoring after launch: feature drift, calibration drift, label-shift checks with sample counts
binding_constraints: daily exports only; small samples; DRIFT_ALERT is an abstain reason

need: Incremental or online updating of a model as matured labels arrive, without retraining on unmatured labels
binding_constraints: MODEL_STALE after 14 days; a model artifact carries its training cutoff

need: Experiment ledger, model registry and lineage: run records, artifact sha256, training cutoff, feature-set fingerprint, data validation
binding_constraints: files with sha256 plus model cards planned (PLANNED_SEAMS); SQLite and git, no new service

need: On-chain, holder and liquidity features and anomaly scores (distribution risk, wallet graphs, rug patterns)
binding_constraints: holder and depth history are not exported; the related targets are BLOCKED_NO_DATA or DEFERRED, so tools here wait for data

need: Social and catalyst narrative features with no future text: sentiment, topic or narrative clustering, deduplication
binding_constraints: catalyst history BLOCKED_NO_DATA; no raw third-party social content in the repo; no paid LLM

need: Behavioral multi-agent simulation that generates testable scenario hypotheses, never probabilities, behind an isolated adapter
binding_constraints: GAP_MATRIX has no behavioral-simulation facility; PLANNED_SEAMS boundary 'Behavioral simulation' (isolated adapter, optional, outside the core package); paid LLM and Zep not approved (PI-D-005)

need: Market and execution context research tools: event-driven backtest or market simulation to compare price-path labels with fee and depth assumptions (research only, no trading)
binding_constraints: BACKTEST_NOT_AVAILABLE (PI-D-006); no historical executable depth; never an order path
